plan.scope: Exploratory paired extension; fixed after original C4 study, not preregistered
plan.assumptions: Weakly dependent, sufficiently stable origin-metric processes with finite moments; overlapping six-month estimation and one-month evaluation windows. Structural changes and small tail samples limit inference.
plan.multiplicity: Holm across every planned contrast and all nine metrics within each family, population and block. Missing tests retain their family slot.

caveats: Same frozen C4 training estimates, market endpoint2026-11-17, universe, retrospective inventory and original sales contract.
Origin-account wealth is not compounded across overlapping monthly tests.
Different attained heuristic policies are compared; no global optimality certificate.
An unavailable fit is not a zero return; paired counts and shared-origin coverage remain explicit.
Passive marked sector weights may exceed30%; new trades cannot increase a grandfathered sector EUR exposure. No compulsory sector sales. No-trade and cash retention are feasible.

constraint_policy.trade_limit: Post-trade sector EUR exposure <= max(30% of account wealth, pre-trade marked sector EUR exposure).
